import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format='%m/%d/%y')
acct = df[df.account_id=='xykrZYR']
daily = acct.groupby('date').unblended_cost.sum()
print(daily.loc['2025-10-15':'2025-10-25'])
# compare 10/20 rows vs baseline (e.g., avg of prior week per row-key)
key = ['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']
base = acct[acct.date.between('2025-10-13','2025-10-19')].groupby(key).unblended_cost.mean().rename('base')
d20 = acct[acct.date=='2025-10-20'].set_index(key).unblended_cost.rename('d20')
cmp = pd.concat([base,d20],axis=1).fillna(0)
cmp['delta']=cmp.d20-cmp.base
print(cmp.sort_values('delta',ascending=False).head(15))

import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format='%m/%d/%y')
acct = df[df.account_id=='xykrZYR'].copy()
key=['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']
pre = acct[acct.date<'2025-10-20'].groupby(key).unblended_cost.mean().rename('pre')
post = acct[acct.date>='2025-10-20'].groupby(key).unblended_cost.mean().rename('post')
cmp=(pd.concat([pre,post],axis=1).fillna(0))
cmp['delta']=cmp.post-cmp.pre
print(cmp.sort_values('delta',ascending=False).head(8))
# check other resources' deltas magnitude vs daily total jump (~+150)

import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format='%m/%d/%y')
acct = df[(df.account_id=='xykrZYR')&(df.date<'2025-10-20')]
# check no other instance family jumped on 10/20 vs its own baseline
key=['instance_family']
base = acct[acct.date.between('2025-10-13','2025-10-19')].groupby(key).unblended_cost.mean()
d20 = acct[acct.date=='2025-10-20'].groupby(key).unblended_cost.sum() if False else df[(df.account_id=='xykrZYR')&(df.date=='2025-10-20')].groupby(key).unblended_cost.sum()
z=(d20-base)/base.std()
print(z.sort_values(ascending=False).head())
